logger.doc:name: Log Email Notification Sent
logger.message: #[output application/json --- { event: "INVENTORY_EMAIL_NOTIFICATION_SENT", runId: vars.runId default "UNKNOWN_RUN", notificationType: vars.notificationType default "GENERAL", recipient: vars.notificationRecipient default Mule::p("email.recipients"), subject: vars.notificationSubject default "[Inventory Integration] Notification", sentAt: (now() >> ("Asia/Kolkata" as TimeZone)) as String { format: "yyyy-MM-dd'T'HH:mm:ss.SSSXXX" } }]

logger.doc:name: Log Email Notification Disabled
logger.message: #[output application/json --- { event: "INVENTORY_EMAIL_NOTIFICATION_SKIPPED", runId: vars.runId default "UNKNOWN_RUN", notificationType: vars.notificationType default "GENERAL", subject: vars.notificationSubject default "[Inventory Integration] Notification", reason: "Email notifications are disabled." }]

logger.doc:name: Log Email Notification Failure
logger.message: #[output application/json --- { event: "INVENTORY_EMAIL_NOTIFICATION_FAILED", runId: vars.runId default "UNKNOWN_RUN", notificationType: vars.notificationType default "GENERAL", recipient: vars.notificationRecipient default Mule::p("email.recipients"), subject: vars.notificationSubject default "[Inventory Integration] Notification", emailErrorType: (error.errorType.namespace default "EMAIL") ++ ":" ++ (error.errorType.identifier default "UNKNOWN"), emailErrorDescription: error.description default "Email notification failed", inventoryProcessingUnaffected: true, failedAt: (now() >> ("Asia/Kolkata" as TimeZone)) as String { format: "yyyy-MM-dd'T'HH:mm:ss.SSSXXX" } }]
